name: IoT-23: Labeled Dataset of IoT Network Malware & Benign Traffic
description: IoT-23 is a semi-automated, labeled dataset of network traffic from Internet of Things (IoT) devices. Created by the Stratosphere Laboratory at Czech Technical University in Prague (CTU), it features 20 malware captures executed on real physical IoT devices and 3 benign IoT network captures, totaling over 325 million network flows with 20.5 million labeled Zeek/Bro connection records.
